name: fated-keepsake-enter-draw-and-prevent-damage
notes: Fated Keepsake (vi1uyifw6s): "On Enter: Draw a card. [Guo Jia Bonus] If your champion would take 7 or more damage while you control three or more Fatestone and/or Fatebound objects, prevent all but 6 of that damage." On Enter (GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php enterAbilities["vi1uyifw6s:0"]) is proven by materializing it for real via FSM play. The prevention clause (Custom/GameLogic.php ApplyFatedKeepsakePrevention(), called from CombatLogic.php's OnDealDamage() whenever amount>=7 and the damaged object is a CHAMPION) is proven with a real damage source: player 1 materializes Fated Keepsake (with Guo Jia as champion and 3 Craggy Fatestone items already on the field), ends their turn, and player 2 (with an ARCANE lineage unlock) casts the already-covered Arcane Blast (11 damage to target champion) at player 1's champion. Verified live: player 1's champion takes exactly 6 damage instead of 11. Break/restore verified independently for both clauses: commenting out Draw() in the On Enter closure fails the draw assertion; commenting out the `return min($amount, 6)` in ApplyFatedKeepsakePrevention lets the full 11 damage through (both restored afterward and the fixture passes again).

rulesClauses: [Guo Jia Bonus] If your champion would take 7 or more damage while you control three or more Fatestone and/or Fatebound objects, prevent all but 6 of that damage.
